description: This file defines the LoopWriter class, which extends java.io.Writer and implements freemarker.template.TransformControl. It provides implementation for controlling the behavior of a FreeMarker template transformation, specifically for looping constructs.

classes.name: LoopWriter
classes.description: A custom Writer implementation that also acts as a FreeMarker TransformControl, managing the evaluation of template bodies during iteration.

methods.name: LoopWriter
methods.description: Constructor for LoopWriter, accepts a Writer object but currently does no initialization.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Invoked at the start of the transformation, instructs FreeMarker to evaluate the body.

methods.name: afterBody
methods.description: Called after the body is processed, indicating to end evaluation.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during transformation, rethrowing any encountered Throwable.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the writer, currently no implementation.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes characters to the underlying writer, currently no implementation.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the writer, currently no implementation.
